title: Astrocyte-Conditioned Media (ACM) Cultures
author: Elena Coccia
materials: Every 4 days, ACM will be harvested.

steps.title: Prepare Mature Astrocyte Media
steps.instruction: Prepare 500 mL of Mature Astrocyte Media.

steps.title: Seed astrocytes and grow to confluence
steps.instruction: Seed astrocytes at 80,000 cells/mL in 100 mm plates, incubate at 37 °C with 5 % CO₂ until confluent, monitoring confluence and replacing media every 4 days.

steps.title: Refresh media and incubate 4 days
steps.instruction: Remove existing media from the flasks, add fresh Mature Astrocyte Media, and incubate undisturbed for an additional 4 days.

steps.title: Collect and clarify conditioned media
steps.instruction: After 4 days, collect the conditioned media into sterile 15 mL centrifuge tubes and centrifuge at 2000 × g for 5 minutes to remove cellular debris.

steps.title: Aliquot and store ACM
steps.instruction: Transfer the clarified supernatant to new sterile tubes and store at –80 °C.

steps.title: Use ACM for organoid/neuronal culture
steps.instruction: Maintain D25 midbrain organoids or 2D neuronal cultures in ACM for 30 days, performing 50 % media exchanges every 3 days.
